tagline: Visual messaging platform and advertising company
hero_kpi_rationale: Daily Active Users (DAU) is a key indicator of user engagement and the health of the Snapchat platform. It is the primary metric to assess the size and growth of the user community.

kpis.name: Daily Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of registered and logged-in users who visit Snapchat at least once per day.
kpis.description: DAU is an important indicator of the health of the Snapchat platform. It measures the base of engaged users and is essential for assessing monetization potential.

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per User
kpis.explanation: Average quarterly revenue generated per daily active user.
kpis.description: ARPU measures the monetization rate of the user base and reflects the effectiveness of the advertising strategy.

kpis.name: Annual Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company for the full year.
kpis.description: Total revenue is an important indicator of the company's financial health and growth, primarily driven by advertising.

kpis.name: Annual Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss after all expenses and financial charges.
kpis.description: Net loss reflects the company's profitability. Improvement compared to the prior year indicates better cost control.
kpis.signal: Indicator of profitability and operational efficiency

kpis.name: Annual Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA shows operational efficiency and the ability to generate cash flow before investment and financing expenses.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the ability to generate operating cash flow

kpis.name: Annual Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated by the company's operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reflects the company's ability to generate cash from its core business operations.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of cash generated from operations

kpis.name: Annual Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow available after capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flow shows the cash available after funding operations and capital investments, reflecting financial flexibility.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of cash available to shareholders and debt repayment

kpis.name: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Marketable Securities
kpis.explanation: Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities available on the balance sheet.
kpis.description: Cash is an important indicator of financial strength and the company's ability to invest in operations and manage risks.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of liquidity and ability to meet financial obligations

risks.title: Decline in user base
risks.score_rationale: DAU growth rate slowed to 5% in 2025. Market saturation and increased competition could reverse growth

risks.title: Targeted advertising regulation
risks.score_rationale: Platform policy changes have affected targeting, measurement, and optimization capabilities, directly impacting advertising revenues

risks.title: Advertising dependency
risks.score_rationale: The majority of revenue comes from advertising, exposing the company to fluctuations in the advertising market and advertiser budget cuts

risks.title: Intensifying competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition for advertising spend has increased and growth in demand on the advertising platform has slowed

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could compromise user and advertising data, impacting trust and reputation

risks.title: Decline in user engagement
risks.score_rationale: Potential decline in engagement due to competition from other social media platforms

risks.title: Regulatory compliance with data protection laws
risks.score_rationale: Increasing data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) limit data collection and use

ai_positioning.summary: Snapchat mentions AI-related partnerships and investments in technology, including agreements with AI platform partners to monetize the platform. However, AI is not positioned as a central element of the publicly stated strategy.
evidence: Agreement with AI platform partner for revenue generation mentioned in 10-K
Continued investment in augmented reality technology and Spectacles
